metadata.name: Travis Scott — Browser Entry
metadata.description: Oasis-style browser flow for SuperSwipe no-payment draws on shop.travisscott.com and victorvictor.com. Selects your size (shoe or apparel; one-size drops need none), dismisses the cookie banner, checks the five draw acknowledgments individually with randomized pauses, fills and verifies shipping details, solves Turnstile through Key Vault and submits. Acknowledgments include terms, privacy and Email/SMS communications. Saves only a visible entry confirmation. Requires Scrolls 1.6.0 or newer. Card draws (off by default): enters SuperSwipe card-on-file draws through Shopify checkout with a Key Vault card, only when $0.00 is due today; the store charges the card later only if you are selected. 0.5.0: card-on-file draws, Victor Victor store, optional product title, apparel and one-size drops.

inputs.label: Store / product URL
inputs.hint: shop.travisscott.com or victorvictor.com. A password-protected store fails until the draw is live.

inputs.label: Exact product title
inputs.hint: Leave blank when the page has a single draw. With several draws, enter the title exactly as shown.

inputs.label: Size selection
inputs.hint: Random chooses from available supported sizes. Size range chooses randomly within your inclusive bounds.

inputs.label: Card draws
inputs.hint: Enter draws that keep a card on file through Shopify checkout. Nothing is due today; the store charges the card later only if you are selected. Stops if checkout shows any amount due today.

inputs.label: Key Vault card ID
inputs.hint: Used only for card draws. Leave blank for the default Key Vault card.

config.script:
if (/^\/password(\/|$)/.test(location.pathname)) throw new Error('The store is password-protected; run again once the draw page is live.');
return true;

config.message: Waiting up to 60 seconds for the site to enable Enter Draw for the selected product.
Checking all five draw acknowledgments, including terms, privacy and Email/SMS communications.
Filling the selected shipping address and contact details.
Solving Turnstile with the configured Key Vault provider, then submitting the draw entry.
Opening Shopify checkout. Busy drops queue checkouts; waiting up to 90 minutes in line.
Filling checkout contact and shipping details.
Entering the Key Vault card ($0 due today).
